status: Authorized candidate collection; revised source allocation, unchanged category weights
paper_distribution_unit: Not specified clearly enough to equate with tokens or documents
proposed_sampling_unit: eligible contiguous human passage; group by original source family before sampling
cutoff_status: Our conservative provenance design, not a reported Pangram 4 rule

sources.name: Project Gutenberg, with Standard Ebooks preferred for matching editions
sources.source_findings: Gutenberg has public-domain and some copyrighted works; Standard Ebooks supplies carefully edited public-domain editions. Rights are work- and jurisdiction-specific.
sources.proposed_selection: English narrative fiction; stratify genre, era, author and original versus translated English. Select the best verified transcription of each work, never count editions as independent. Prefer historical archived editions; PG-19 train can supply a reproducible fallback after checking its substitutions.
remaining_checks: Exclude the locally evaluated PG-19 test works and related editions. Check publication and transcription history; remove headers and editorial additions. Contemporary fiction remains undercovered.

sources.name: WritingPrompts original 2018 release
sources.source_findings: The authors provide original prompt/story splits alongside separate model-generated samples. The README does not establish a commercial license for the underlying Reddit stories.
sources.proposed_selection: Original training stories only; separate prompt from story. Preserve paragraph structure when recoverable. Stratify genre and length, including ordinary prose rather than only highly voted stories.
remaining_checks: Hold this quota pending text rights. Reconstruct missing identity metadata where possible; otherwise quarantine uncertain groups. Remove all overlap with existing detector benchmarks. Never import generated samples.

sources.name: SCP Foundation prose tales
sources.source_findings: SCP documents a CC BY-SA 3.0 framework with attribution and explicit exceptions for some non-text assets.
sources.proposed_selection: Exact pre-2022 revisions of English tales; favor narrative stories over repetitive containment templates. Cap this fictional universe at its allocated share.
remaining_checks: Verify historical revision retrieval and text license; omit images, third-party quotations, credits and navigation. Current page creation date alone is insufficient.

sources.name: Wikisource proofread short fiction
sources.source_findings: Wikisource hosts public-domain and freely licensed texts with work-specific copyright information.
sources.proposed_selection: Proofread or validated fiction and short stories with scans; prioritize works absent from Gutenberg. Exclude verse, drama and nonfiction from this first prose mixture.
remaining_checks: Preserve scan edition and proofreading evidence; deduplicate anthologies, excerpts and translations; distinguish historical text from recent annotations.

sources.name: PMC Open Access commercial-reuse subset
sources.source_findings: PMC availability is not blanket permission; the OA subset exposes article-level reuse terms and supported machine-access routes.
sources.proposed_selection: CC BY or CC0 articles with verified pre-2022 text versions; extract body sections from JATS. Balance journals, article types and specialties; keep abstracts a minority.
remaining_checks: Exclude corrected post-cutoff text, references, notices, quoted copyrighted material and benchmark ancestors. Deduplicate against arXiv, ACL and peS2o.

sources.name: arXiv full texts with suitable article licenses
sources.source_findings: arXiv licenses vary by article; its metadata license is distinct from full-text rights.
sources.proposed_selection: CC BY, CC BY-SA or CC0 full texts; exact versions submitted by 2021-12-31. Balance mathematics, physics, CS, engineering, economics and statistics; do not build an abstracts-only pool.
remaining_checks: Default arXiv distribution permission is not a blanket commercial adaptation license. Parse TeX without executing it. Verify version-level dates and paper-family overlaps.

sources.name: Common Pile licensed peS2o subset
sources.source_findings: The Common Pile peS2o release is a separately curated source with its own metadata; it must not be conflated with every peS2o or S2ORC release.
sources.proposed_selection: Use for fields missing from PMC/arXiv/ACL: environmental science, engineering, psychology, education and social sciences. Require original document license evidence and a pre-2022 text version.
remaining_checks: Do not rely on an open-access flag alone; audit PDF extraction, page order and source dates. Unknown version date remains quarantined.

sources.name: ACL-owned proceedings from 2016–2021
sources.source_findings: ACL states CC BY 4.0 for its material from 2016 onward and CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 for earlier material; third-party proceedings need separate checks.
sources.proposed_selection: Human prose from 2016–2021 papers across NLP subfields and paper sections, excluding all existing local paper families. Retain citation metadata separately.
remaining_checks: Apply per-paper ownership checks. Existing local 2013–2021 paper data is not automatically cleared under the newer license.

sources.name: English Wikipedia historical article revisions
sources.source_findings: Wikimedia provides licensed text and database dumps. Revision history is needed to recover historical text rather than merely historical page creation dates.
sources.proposed_selection: Latest eligible revision at or before 2021-12-31. Broad subject strata; take lead and body prose. Exclude lists, disambiguation, templates, copyvio pages and bot-created stubs.
remaining_checks: Retain attribution/history and applicable license version. If a mirror lacks revision timestamps, use a dated dump or history reconstruction instead.

sources.name: Pressbooks openly licensed textbook editions
sources.source_findings: Pressbooks Directory exposes license filters and includes both open and restricted books.
sources.proposed_selection: CC BY, CC BY-SA or CC0 editions from before 2022. Balance humanities, social sciences, health, STEM and vocational education; choose explanatory prose with clean HTML or EPUB.
remaining_checks: A catalog hit is not a text grant; inspect book and chapter notices. Merge clones, remixes and duplicate OER catalog entries. Historical edition evidence required.

sources.name: LibreTexts selected book and page licenses
sources.source_findings: The Common Pile provides a LibreTexts source. License and source provenance still need checking on the particular book or page.
sources.proposed_selection: Historical CC BY/CC BY-SA explanatory prose, with material beyond chemistry and biology. Keep derivations only when accompanied by readable prose.
remaining_checks: Many reused textbooks have different licenses. Exclude NC/ND for the default pool; remove exercise keys and table-only content.

sources.name: English Wikibooks historical chapters
sources.source_findings: Wikibooks text is part of the Wikimedia licensing and attribution framework.
sources.proposed_selection: Pre-2022 revisions of coherent explanatory chapters. Favor practical and humanities material underrepresented in the other reference sources.
remaining_checks: Exclude incomplete stubs, copied Wikipedia pages and code-dominated chapters. Keep whole-book families in one split.

sources.name: Amazon Review Data 2018
sources.source_findings: The original release reports 233.1 million reviews from May 1996–October 2018 with review, product and user metadata. Public download alone does not establish rights to the review text.
sources.proposed_selection: Sample original review text from full per-category files, not ratings-only or five-core-only subsets. Cover home, apparel, electronics, books, beauty, outdoor, toys and other products; include middle ratings.
remaining_checks: Hold commercial-use quota until underlying rights are documented. Fake, incentivized and templated reviews remain possible even before LLMs. Remove product descriptions and seller replies.

sources.name: Yelp Open Dataset historical reviews
sources.source_findings: Yelp publishes an academic-use agreement. The dataset is not an unrestricted commercial-text release.
sources.proposed_selection: If appropriate rights are available, select archived pre-2022 reviews across restaurants, retail, hospitality and local services; stratify ratings, region and length.
remaining_checks: Retain a historical snapshot, not just an old date on a current edited record. Academic eligibility and permitted uses must match the actual project.

sources.name: Stanford Large Movie Review Dataset
sources.source_findings: The 2011 corpus contains labeled positive/negative reviews and an additional unlabeled split. The labeled selection is polarized.
sources.proposed_selection: Use eligible training and unlabeled originals after benchmark exclusion, with a small quota because long film criticism differs from typical product reviews.
remaining_checks: Verify underlying text rights; do not import the official test split or benchmark copies. Positive/negative balance is not the natural consumer rating distribution.

sources.name: OpinRank hotel and car reviews
sources.source_findings: UCI labels this 2011 collection CC BY 4.0; its text originates from Tripadvisor and Edmunds. The upstream grant still needs verification.
sources.proposed_selection: Hotel and automotive narratives diversify the review category. Balance cities and product types and retain original dates and review IDs.
remaining_checks: Do not infer that a repository license settles the rights of upstream reviewers. Audit extraction and duplicate review fields.

sources.name: Stack Exchange non-programming answers
sources.source_findings: Public contributions use CC BY-SA with license versions changing over time. Dump access arrangements have also changed.
sources.proposed_selection: Pre-2022 answer revisions from cooking, travel, history, philosophy, parenting, workplace, personal finance, writing and English usage. Use whole answers; store questions as context rather than prepend to detector text.
remaining_checks: Preserve post-level attribution, dates and license. Remove quotations and code without rewriting prose. Current dumps can contain post-cutoff edits.

sources.name: Stack Exchange technical explanations
sources.source_findings: The same contribution-license framework covers technical Stack Exchange sites.
sources.proposed_selection: Explanatory prose from science, mathematics, statistics and computing sites. Cap code and formula dominance; retain accessible explanations and uncertain or imperfect answers.
remaining_checks: Use disjoint site/post routing from the nontechnical quota. Do not select solely by votes or detector score.

sources.name: Ubuntu IRC historical conversations
sources.source_findings: The Common Pile publishes a source assembled from historical Ubuntu IRC logs.
sources.proposed_selection: Pre-2022 coherent conversations with intact turn boundaries; exclude bot output, commands, server events and unrelated concatenated messages. Retain a distinct chat stratum.
remaining_checks: Verify public-domain release basis in source documentation and event dates. Thread segmentation is harder than for Q&A; exclude uncertain context. Mostly technical community, not broad social media.

sources.name: Wikipedia human discussion threads
sources.source_findings: Article talk pages provide discussion rather than encyclopedia prose under Wikimedia text terms.
sources.proposed_selection: Pre-2022 signed discussion turns grouped into threads; retain disagreements and informal reasoning. Remove bot notices, signatures from model text, and extensive quotations.
remaining_checks: History and thread boundaries required; related article topic families must not cross protected splits. Do not count these as encyclopedic reference text.

sources.name: Common Pile Creative Commons Common Crawl
sources.source_findings: The source is organized by Common Crawl snapshot; its collection pipeline includes license tagging and domain review.
sources.proposed_selection: Only crawl snapshots through 2021, with document-level license evidence. Route scientific, reference, reviews and news out before filling this residual category; retain blogs, hobbies, how-to and personal nonfiction.
remaining_checks: License markers can describe an image rather than text. Audit domains and extraction; cap any one domain at 5% of this category. Do not use a recent crawl merely because the page claims an old date.

sources.name: EFF historical Deeplinks articles
sources.source_findings: EFF currently licenses original material CC BY 4.0 unless otherwise noted and distinguishes third-party content.
sources.proposed_selection: Archive-proven pre-2022 original explainers and opinion pieces. Limit this technology-policy voice to the assigned small share.
remaining_checks: Check historical content and license notice, quotations and republications. Retain clear bylines; do not include action widgets or footers.

sources.name: Foodista narrative food writing
sources.source_findings: A dedicated Common Pile Foodista source provides a concrete route to food-related web text.
sources.proposed_selection: Pre-2022 narrative introductions, original food articles and explanatory cooking prose. Retain title/recipe context separately; exclude ingredient-only lists.
remaining_checks: Check source-level and document-level license notices and historical version dates. Keep user comments separate; do not pad prose with ingredients to reach a word threshold.

sources.name: Wikivoyage travel prose
sources.source_findings: Wikivoyage is a Wikimedia travel-writing source with reusable text under its applicable terms.
sources.proposed_selection: Pre-2022 destination and practical-travel prose, broad region balance, without listing tables or coordinates. Assign here only once.
remaining_checks: Descriptions are not consumer reviews. Deduplicate Wikitravel imports and related mirrors; verify revision-level attribution.

sources.name: Global Voices original English news
sources.source_findings: Global Voices specifies CC BY 3.0 for its original content; third-party content is treated separately.
sources.proposed_selection: Pre-2022 original English reporting and identified human translations, with wide regional coverage. Keep translations linked to the same story family.
remaining_checks: Quoted social posts are not automatically covered by the outlet license. Preserve publication and capture evidence; remove embedded posts when rights/provenance are uncertain.

sources.name: Voice of America original reporting
sources.source_findings: VOA distinguishes its own public-domain productions from third-party wire content.
sources.proposed_selection: Historical original VOA-authored text only; balance geography and subject. Require byline/source evidence to distinguish Reuters, AP and AFP copies.
remaining_checks: Reject mixed or unclear wire attribution; dates need historical version/capture support. Outlet policy is not permission for every hosted article.

sources.name: Wikinews archived reporting
sources.source_findings: Wikinews uses different text-license regimes across dates; historical articles are not uniformly covered by the current CC BY version.
sources.proposed_selection: Pre-2022 published article revisions; prioritize reviewed reporting over incomplete drafts and short briefs. Keep article families and quoted source material identifiable.
remaining_checks: Record the applicable historical license, usually CC BY 2.5 for this period; exclude third-party quotations where needed.

sources.name: SciDev.Net original science and development journalism
sources.source_findings: SciDev.Net publishes CC BY reuse policies, with different version numbers on its policy and media pages.
sources.proposed_selection: Pre-2022 reporting written for general readers; balance regions and avoid filling the scientific-paper category with these stories.
remaining_checks: Pin article-level license and historical text; distinguish guest/third-party material. Do not silently resolve conflicting policy-version numbers.

sources.name: OANC contributed Slate journalism
sources.source_findings: OANC states unrestricted commercial use for its released subset and includes historical Slate material. This does not grant rights to arbitrary Slate articles.
sources.proposed_selection: Use only the contributed OANC files; stratify topics and separate opinion/criticism from reporting. Preserve original article metadata.
remaining_checks: Audit the release notices; deduplicate MASC and other OANC-derived copies. Historical US magazine prose is a limited slice, not current global news.

sources.name: ASAP 2.0 original training essays
sources.source_findings: The publisher states CC BY 4.0 and 24,278 source-based student essays over seven prompts. There is substantial PERSUADE overlap; its reported component counts do not sum to the headline count.
sources.proposed_selection: Train split only, original essay text and all score bands. Balance prompts, grades and documented ELL status without feeding demographic fields to the detector.
remaining_checks: Exact collection dates and permitted writing tools were not established by the inspected preprint. Resolve human provenance before admission. Match overlapping PERSUADE essays and exclude every benchmark family.

sources.name: ELLIPSE original reliable training essays
sources.source_findings: The official release describes about 6,500 reliably scored learner essays and a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license. A larger raw collection includes less reliable items.
sources.proposed_selection: If permitted, use original train essays across proficiency bands, without proofreading or language-model cleanup; retain one row per essay.
remaining_checks: Local ELLIPSE evaluation already exists. Exclude its protected originals and related prompts; do not automatically promote local cached data into training. Check collection dates.

sources.name: British Academic Written English
sources.source_findings: BAWE contains 2,761 assessed university texts from 2004–2007 across disciplines; its published access description is for noncommercial researchers.
sources.proposed_selection: If permitted, sample humanities, social sciences, life sciences and physical sciences; include undergraduate and masters work. Remove assignment prompts and instructor annotations.
remaining_checks: Registration and actual use terms need satisfaction. These are proficient assessed texts, so they cannot replace learner essays. Check references and quoted assigned readings.
sources.forfeiture_reason: BAWE registration/access conditions and noncommercial restriction

sources.name: PERSUADE original essays with version-specific rights
sources.source_findings: The PERSUADE 2.0 repository says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, while The Learning Agency Lab labels its PERSUADE offering CC BY 4.0. These may describe different releases.
sources.proposed_selection: Prioritize independent-prompt essays absent from ASAP 2.0 to add rhetorical variety. Resolve exact file/release and license before choosing rows.
remaining_checks: Do not transfer the more permissive statement to all versions. Exclude duplicate annotation rows and ASAP overlap; establish collection-date provenance.

sources.name: GovReport original CRS and GAO reports
sources.source_findings: GovReport offers a concrete 2021 release of long government reports paired with summaries.
sources.proposed_selection: Use original report bodies from eligible training files, with summary text stored separately. Balance policy topics and report sections, excluding tables and repeated agency boilerplate.
remaining_checks: Verify source-level government authorship and third-party inclusions. Exclude official benchmark test documents and all related update versions.

sources.name: Federal Reserve Board reports and policy prose
sources.source_findings: The Board describes its site information as public domain unless indicated otherwise; third-party material is excluded.
sources.proposed_selection: Pre-2022 original monetary-policy, financial-stability and explanatory report prose. Use archived PDFs/HTML with identifiable dates and versions.
remaining_checks: Do not extend the Board policy automatically to regional banks or third-party working papers. Remove tables and repeated release templates.

sources.name: World Bank openly licensed reports
sources.source_findings: The repository contains multiple licenses, including CC BY and restricted NC/ND variants, with separate third-party content conditions.
sources.proposed_selection: Select historical CC BY or CC BY IGO reports with country and sector diversity. Prefer narrative findings, executive explanations and professional recommendations.
remaining_checks: Check each work and embedded material; do not substitute general website terms for the work license. Retain exact edition and archive evidence.

sources.name: OANC ICIC professional correspondence
sources.source_findings: The contributed ICIC portion includes fundraising letters, grant proposals, case statements and annual reports.
sources.proposed_selection: Use only the released OANC ICIC files. Retain natural persuasive and administrative prose, with names/contact details withheld from model text where appropriate.
remaining_checks: Small supply; do not repeat letters to fill quotas. Audit inherited release notices and overlap with MASC. Ordinary corporate email remains a coverage gap.

sources.name: FineWeb / FineWeb-Edu historical snapshots
sources.source_findings: ODC-By is a compilation license, not a blanket grant for webpage text. Educational filtering is not human-authorship certification.
sources.proposed_selection: Use only if upstream rights and pre-2022 capture evidence can be established; broad web is preferable to only high educational scores.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.

sources.name: OpenStax historical editions
sources.source_findings: Current official licensing guidance lists CC BY-NC-SA. Older CC BY editions need their own exact content and license evidence.
sources.proposed_selection: Recover a verifiable old edition before admitting it; do not label the entire present catalog CC BY.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.

sources.name: OpenIntro Statistics
sources.source_findings: A concrete educational text candidate; license must be checked inside the selected historical edition.
sources.proposed_selection: Useful editorial-quality anchor, too few independent titles to dominate a large pool.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.

sources.name: PELIC learner corpus
sources.source_findings: The release uses CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Local PELIC evaluation data also exists.
sources.proposed_selection: Restricted alternative for longitudinal learner writing; verify use permission, student grouping and benchmark separation.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.

sources.name: BEA 2019 Write & Improve / LOCNESS
sources.source_findings: The task page specifies noncommercial use for these learner corpora.
sources.proposed_selection: Retain original learner sentences, not corrected or system outputs; reconstruct document and student groups.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.

sources.name: Amazon multilingual review corpus
sources.source_findings: The official license limits use to academic research and forbids commercial use.
sources.proposed_selection: Potential multilingual research comparator, not a default replacement for missing commercial review rights.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.

sources.name: Amazon Reviews 2023
sources.source_findings: The release extends through September 2023; old timestamps do not prove unchanged historical text.
sources.proposed_selection: Prefer the 2018 snapshot for human provenance; investigate this only for coverage gaps with version checks.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.

sources.name: Public Domain Review essays
sources.source_findings: Most essays carry CC BY-SA, but some have more restrictive terms.
sources.proposed_selection: Small professionally edited essay anchor; distinguish it from student writing and identify quoted book extracts.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.

sources.name: MASC manually annotated corpus
sources.source_findings: The project states CC BY 3.0 US and offers about 500,000 words across genres.
sources.proposed_selection: Best as a small extraction-quality audit; overlaps OANC, so never count it as independent scale.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.

sources.name: European Commission Horizon magazine
sources.source_findings: The publisher states CC BY 4.0 for articles.
sources.proposed_selection: Historical science journalism backup for SciDev quota after edition checks; not general-news replacement.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.

sources.name: Common Pile source collection
sources.source_findings: A source collection and collection-code route, not an extra independent donor.
sources.proposed_selection: Use selected sources only; exclude code, patents, ASR transcripts and modern unverified text from this proposed written-prose pool.
remaining_checks: Zero-weight alternative; no automatic substitution or admission.
